ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Writers and Sino-Japanese Cultural Interaction 600-1900. What is the East Asian cultural sphere? How did cultural interaction with China shape the literary cultures of East Asian countries? What role did women writers play in the process? How did attitudes toward China and Japan evolve over time? In this course, we will answer these questions and many other while exploring a wide range of literary, philosophical, and religious texts from the early days of Sino-Japanese contact to the 1900s. All reading will be in English. Earlier coursework in East Asian studies desirable. “Graded” workload for graduate and undergraduate students.
